name: Ano Shop Window o Wasurenai
original_name: あのショーウィンドウを忘れない
source:
You're just a regular girl. One day, on your way home, you notice a clothes shop you've never seen before.

The people inside seem to be trapped.

You meet a mysterious gentleman, get sucked into the shop window, and while fighting villains, you get to meet beautiful men...

[Translated from [url=http://lightbreeze.ivory.ne.jp/game/anosyo.htm]the official website[/url]]
translation: 你只是一个普通女孩。某天回家路上，你注意到一家从未见过的服装店，店里的人似乎被困住了。你遇见一位神秘绅士，随后被吸进橱窗。在与反派战斗的过程中，你将邂逅英俊的男性……[译自[url=http://lightbreeze.ivory.ne.jp/game/anosyo.htm]官方网站[/url]]
